content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Walk the Avenue of the Dead and climb the Pyramid of the Sun for a view that has watched over this valley for centuries."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Blue house, painted stories, and a garden that still holds Frida's quiet defiance."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tostadas, churros, and the hum of Coyoacán's everyday bargaining."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Vegan tacos al pastor that even the sceptics in your crew will eye with sudden respect."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"The castle's terraces give you the whole city like a gift, and the murals inside tell its story in colour."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A green lung big enough to get lost in, with lakes and paths that make the city feel far away."},{"poi_id":"p20","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A calm, friendly table with halal and vegetarian plates that please everyone before the flight home."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Glide the old canals on a painted trajinera, the city's floating heart."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Grab a classic al pastor taco, carved straight off the trompo."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander stalls of chiles, crickets and butchers who know their craft."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stroll leafy Roma's art deco corners and quiet café terraces."},{"poi_id":"p17","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Settle in for a long, inventive tasting menu that plays with memory."}]}
Coyoacán to Chapultepec, with pyramids and canals in between — every must-do made it, and I'm already practising my floating mariachi.
